name: Invoice Parser - Claude Code (Simple - No FS)

parameters.command:
=Set-Location "C:\Users\itama\Dropbox\Docs Itamar\Scripts\Claude-code"; $prompt = @"
Parse this invoice.

Vendor data (extract email from any format - JSON string/object/array/plain):
{{ $json.vendor }}

Invoice text (parse from any format - JSON array string/array/plain):
{{ $json.text }}

EmailId: {{ $json.emailId }}
ThreadId: {{ $json.threadId }}

Instructions:
1. Parse vendor field to extract email address (handle JSON strings, objects, arrays)
2. Parse text field to get clean invoice text (handle JSON array strings, arrays)
3. Read vendor-parsers/vendor-mapping.json to find matching vendor by email
4. If vendor found: read and execute the parser file
5. If vendor not found: create new parser, update mapping, then parse
6. Return ONLY JSON with invoice data, no explanations
"@; echo $prompt | claude --no-stream
